scope: Eight original geometry contracts; public official 2020 resource and ratified errata review, plus legacy text cross-check
verification_limitation: Official no-cost download reaches PDF Association cart/checkout; no account, personal details, checkout or download performed. Public errata is a correction set, not the complete standard. Unreproduced clauses/rows are explicitly not fully verified; no absence-of-errata claim proves unchanged text.
version_correction: All eight current fixture bytes declare PDF-2.0, not PDF-1.7. They use legacy features; 2008 references govern a separately authored 1.7 variant only. No headers, inputs, expectations or hashes changed in this documentation pass.

sources.finding: Official landing page identifies ISO 32000-2:2020 with Errata Collection 3 as current distributed core edition.
Verified public headings 8.4.2, 8.4.4/Table56, 8.5.3.1/Table59; balanced q/Q correction applies.
Verified public heading 7.7.3.3/Table31; displayed corrections concern Contents/ID/B, not the geometry rows.
Read-only download link resolved here; no full standard acquired.
